description.es: Los hallazgos del entregable en una planilla de Excel lista para el cliente o para seguir la remediación: severidad con su color, activos afectados, descripción y recomendación, con filtros y la primera fila fija. Hecho en Python, sin librerías externas.
description.en: The deliverable's findings in an Excel sheet ready for the client or to track remediation: severity with its color, affected assets, description and remediation, with filters and the first row frozen. Made in Python, with no external libraries.

operations.name: excel
operations.description: Writes the deliverable's findings (approved and later states) as an Excel sheet among the plugin's files: severity colored, affected assets, description, remediation, with filters.
